name: Linux AppImage Collection
tagline: Massive catalog and distribution registry of portable apps and AppImages
description: The largest curated census and distribution registry of AppImages and portable applications for GNU/Linux, maintained by the Portable-Linux-Apps initiative and the AM application manager. Provides automated installation scripts, update checking, and verification for hundreds of Linux desktop applications.
features: Access to an index of over 2,000 Linux portable applications and AppImages
Integrated with AM CLI package manager for one-liner app installations
Automated checksum validation and upstream release mirror verification
Sandboxing and desktop launcher generation out of the box
